abilities.effect: Every 3 s, restores 25 HP (never above max) to the single most-damaged other living enemy within 5 m. Skips herself, dead and rising enemies; nothing happens if no ally is damaged. Body HP only (extra pools such as the Street Vendor shield are untouched).
abilities.name: Stitch Up

abilities.effect: 8 damage per shears chop every 1.0 s (1 hit per swing loop).
abilities.name: Shears Chop

abilities.effect: 6 damage per hit every 1.0 s (1 hit per swing loop).
abilities.name: Siege
abilities.trigger: Within 1.3 m of the dais wall (inherited)

clipAnnotations.attack: 1.0 s loop at native 1.0x speed: overhead shears raise (0.3 s), chop lands at 0.5 s; 1 plant bite and 1 house hit per loop.
clipAnnotations.die: One-shot 1.6 s: startled, sits down, tape measure and silk bolt slump, then she shrinks away; then freed.
clipAnnotations.heal: One-shot 1.0 s needle-and-thread flourish: right arm lifts and stitches a figure eight in the air while the silk bolt bobs. Cosmetic only; the heal itself is the TailorZombie.gd timer.
clipAnnotations.walk: 1.2 s loop at native 1.0x: unhurried shuffle with a small bob every 0.3 s, shears swinging at the side, silk bolt under the left arm.

lore: Stitches the wounds of nearby spirits. Cut her thread before the others.
mechanism: Healer: a fragile Hungry Ghost (70 HP, 0.6 m/s). Every heal_interval she scans the Enemies group (skipped when she is alone) with a squared-distance check against heal_radius, picks the most-damaged other living enemy and calls HungryGhost.heal(heal_amount), clamped to its max health. All march/seek/eat/siege AI, health bar and materials inherited.
name: Tailor Zombie
